Name: Kedi's Kids Furniture
Author: KeDili
Description:
[size=3]This is a mod that adds various furniture and toys with various colors and shapes to your game. Children deserve love! We all are sure they’ll love them.

[b]The mod requires 2 frameworks: [/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Dynamic Game Assets (Needed only if you're on 1.5) ( [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365[/url] )[/size]
[*][size=3]Content Patcher (Needed only if you're on 1.6) ( [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915[/url]﻿ )[/size]
[*][size=3]Alternative Textures ( [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246[/url] )[/size]
[/list][size=3]After installing those and all of their requirements, just unzip and drop the mod to your Mods folder, and give your kids the love and toys that they need!

All of the furniture can be bought from Robin’s shop.

[b][color=#f4f4f4]Known Bug:[/color][/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Some of the furniture may turn into complete or half chairs when put on a table. This is a known bug with DGA itself, so nothing I can really do to solve. (Thanks to StardewStardude for reporting!)[/size]
[/list][size=3]If you find a bug that’s not known, please go to [url=https://smapi.io/log]https://smapi.io/log[/url] , upload your log by reading the instructions on that website, and send a bug report to me with the link it’ll give you! (Also attach a visual item (Image/Video) if it's a visual issue.)

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/108727003?tab=user+files]Check out my other mods here![/url]

[/size][size=1](Tiny reminder: Please endorse the mods you enjoy, so more people will see the mod and the author(s) will be happier!)[/size]
